scripts.check: pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run platform && pnpm run style && pnpm run deps && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.style: node tools/build-style.mjs && node tools/check-style.mjs && git diff --exit-code packages/map/style/

pnpm.$comment: ONE React for the whole workspace. packages/ui and packages/map declare react as a peer with range '*'; pnpm's auto-install-peers happily satisfied that with a DIFFERENT patch than the one Expo SDK 57 pins, which puts two Reacts in one bundle ('Invalid hook call'). These overrides make the pin structural rather than a convention. Bump them together with the Expo SDK, never alone.
